instructions.baseline: Continue pursues the same objective; refine changes its scope while retaining identity; interrupt temporarily parks it for another objective; replace abandons it for another; new introduces work when no active objective exists. Preserve the research subject during refinement.
instructions.treatment: Continue pursues the same objective; refine changes its scope while retaining identity; interrupt temporarily parks it for another objective; replace abandons it for another; new introduces work when no active objective exists. Preserve the research subject during refinement. Compare the requested outcome with the explicitly recorded objective before classifying. A new requirement, constraint, evaluation dimension, or output format is refine even when the main topic is unchanged. Repeating an already-recorded requirement without changing it is continue. Negated additions are not additions. Do not infer unstated requirements. For refine, return the complete updated objective retaining existing requirements and the requested change.

scoring.secondary: For refinement, case-insensitive required-term containment and retention of context reuse in the description; lexical proxy only
